# kion_scope_criteria (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion ScopeCriteria by scope_id and criteria_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_scope_criteria" "example" {
  # Required
  criteria_id = 1
  scope_id    = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria_id` (Number)
- `scope_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `criteria` (String)
- `end_month` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `start_month` (Number)
